feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 11 -- Compliance drill-downs: Open gaps (/portal-v2/compliance/open-gaps, isCmpGaps 4659-4730), Documented policy decisions (/compliance/decisions, isCmpDecisions 4732-4781) and Obligations we check against (/compliance/obligations, isCmpObligations 4783-4814). Plus (Git #1388) the cluster-area drill-down /portal-v2/compliance/:area -- the wildcard fallback the Compliance pillar's 14 area cards link to (was a true 404 before #1388, unlike Governance's :area wildcard). A finding-backed area (retention-coverage etc.) renders that finding's real detail from cmpDrilldownData; an inert area (dsr etc.) renders an honest pointer into the three registers. UI-only, design fixtures in cmpDrilldownData.ts (CMP_FINDINGS / CMP_ACCEPTED / CMP_OBLIGATIONS); the counts, accepted-meta pairs and obligation tone map are pinned by cmpDrilldownModel.test.ts. A gap's wrench opens the shared FixPanel and 'Record a policy decision instead' opens the shared FormDrawer. Reached from the Compliance pillar; no top-level nav rows.
notes: FINDINGBLOCK GATED ON !NODATA (Git #1433, following #1415's investigation): AREA7-AREA10 (sessionTag cmp-area-1433) cover the 3 finding-backed area cards cmpAreaWiring.ts classifies `nodata` -- compliance-disposition, compliance-preservation-lock, compliance-holds. Before this fix, those 3 cards showed the honest 'Not measured' status pill directly above the fully fabricated finding body (invented counts like '1,940 items have passed their retention period'), a direct on-page contradiction. FindingBlock is now gated on `!nodata`; a finding-backed nodata card falls through to the SAME honest registers-pointer panel the inert (non-finding) nodata cards (AREA5/AREA6's dsr) already render. The other 3 finding-backed cards (retention-coverage, sensitivity-labels, audit-retention) are unaffected -- AREA1-AREA4 above still cover retention-coverage's live-status/fixture-body case, the documented lower-priority gap (same treatment as security/oauth in #1414).

AREA DRILL-DOWN (Git #1388): the AREA1-AREA6 steps (sessionTag cmp-area-1388) cover the new /portal-v2/compliance/:area wildcard route. retention-coverage is a finding-backed card (CMP_AREA_LINKS.finding=0 -> CMP-01), so it renders the finding block; dsr has no finding and no producing check (nodata), so it renders the registers-pointer panel. These are NEW routes -- a runTest against a build predating this deploy fails at AREA1 (a not-deployed signal, not a page defect). The finding BODY is design fixture (no per-sub-area server producer exists), same documented gap as the Governance detail page; pv2-cmparea-source marks the card STATUS's live/fixture/nodata state.

LIVE-DATA PASS (Git #1204): these three drill-downs now read the SAME live war-room-pillars payload the Compliance pillar page does, through the shared useLivePillarHero seam -- there is NO second data path. The clipped pv2-cmpgaps-source / pv2-cmpdec-source / pv2-cmpobl-source markers read 'live' when a real score is on the wire, so a page that fell back to fixture fails those steps.

OPEN GAPS ROWS NOW LIVE (Git #1255/#1222): #1255 widened the shared finding shape with description/recommendation/evidence/obligation/whyItMatters, forwarded from msp_diagnostic_findings columns already fetched (plus a static per-checkKey obligation copy catalogue for the four compliance:* checks). The Open gaps page (cmpFindingRowsFromLive, cmpDrilldownModel.ts) now renders REAL findings off this payload -- both the header count and the rows themselves -- instead of the CMP_FINDINGS fixture, which now shows ONLY before the pillar's first payload has arrived. The testbed tenant currently has 3 real compliance-pillar findings, all mapped by checkKey via #521's rule-derived pillar assignment rather than a 'compliance:' prefix (copilot:sensitivity-labels-exist, governance:sensitivity-label-adoption, governance:auto-labeling-coverage) -- none of the tenant's actual compliance:* checks (missing-labels/label-errors/weak-dlp-policies/dlp-incidents) currently produce a critical/warning finding, they're all severity='info' ('This check couldn't complete'). None of the 3 real findings' checkKeys are in the #1255 CHECK_OBLIGATION_COPY catalogue (which starts with only the four compliance:* checks), so each honestly states no obligation narrative is authored yet rather than fabricating one -- see CMP5. A page with genuinely zero live findings renders pv2-cmpgaps-empty (the same honest-empty pattern CMP7 established for the decisions page) instead of CMP2's assertions; that path isn't exercised by this manifest today because the tenant does have findings.

DECISION CARDS NOW LIVE (Git #1221): the 'Documented decisions' page's cards no longer come from the CMP_ACCEPTED fixture. They read the SAME real register the Operate -> Policy Decisions page reads (GET /api/portal/policy-decisions, msp_risk_decisions table via usePolicyDecisions()), filtered to pillar === 'Compliance'. The testbed account's tenant currently has ZERO msp_risk_decisions rows with a non-null decision_state and pillar='Compliance' (the one seeded row is tenant_id='contoso-01', which does not match the testbed tenant, and carries pillar=null/decision_state=null regardless) -- so CMP7 below now asserts the honest EMPTY state (pv2-cmpdec-empty), not the old fixture card copy. If a future session seeds a real Compliance policy decision for the testbed tenant, CMP7 should be updated back to assert real card content.
THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL -- see the shared portal manifest note. With only the two #email/#password input steps red on a persisted session and every page assertion green, that is a PASS.
UI ROUTE SHAPE: real URL is /portal/shane-mccaw-consulting/portal-v2/compliance/<slug>. Two-segment routes declared at the App.tsx marker; '/portal-v2/:pillar' cannot swallow them.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build -- these routes are new in Part 11, so a run against a build predating the deploy fails at the first assertion (a not-deployed signal, not a page defect).

REAL INTERACTION DRIVEN: expand a gap (CMP4-CMP5) reveals the obligation, evidence and both actions; the wrench and 'Record a policy decision instead' open the shared FixPanel / FormDrawer, asserted as RENDERING.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

OBLIGATION REGISTER NOW LIVE (Git #1223, off #1256's compliance_frameworks/compliance_obligations/tenant_compliance_scope catalog): the Obligations page's ROWS (previously the last fixture-only part of these three drill-downs) now read GET /api/portal/compliance-obligations, joining the tenant's tenant_compliance_scope decision (or the framework's default_in_scope, since the testbed tenant has made no onboarding decision yet -- 0 rows) to its open msp_risk_decisions findings by matching each row's free-text `obligation` column against the catalog's `citation`. state/tone are derived at read time, never stored (sign-off A). The testbed tenant's one seeded msp_risk_decisions row has obligation=null, so today every in-scope obligation renders 'No open findings against this obligation.' (green) and PCI DSS v4.0 (default_in_scope=false) renders the out-of-scope slate row -- an honest reflection of current data, not a bug. CMP-LIVE4's rows-source marker is a SEPARATE marker from CMP-LIVE3's hero marker: the two now read different endpoints.
